title: Principles of PTI handling for 5GSM procedures

entities.name: Procedure Transaction Identity
entities.description: Identifier used in 5GSM procedures to correlate request, command, and response messages within a transaction.

entities.name: UE-requested transaction related procedure
entities.description: A procedure initiated by the UE consisting of multiple related messages.

entities.name: Network-requested transaction related procedure
entities.description: A procedure initiated by the network consisting of multiple related messages.

entities.name: Transaction related request message
entities.description: Message initiating a UE-requested transaction procedure, containing a PTI value.

entities.name: Transaction related command message
entities.description: Message initiating a network-requested transaction procedure, may contain PTI from request or unassigned value.

entities.name: Transaction related response message
entities.description: Message responding to a request or command, echoing the received PTI value.

entities.name: Transaction related accept message
entities.description: Message accepting a UE-requested procedure, containing the PTI from the request.

entities.name: Transaction related reject message
entities.description: Message rejecting a UE-requested procedure, containing the PTI from the request.

entities.name: No procedure transaction identity assigned
entities.description: Condition where PTI is set to indicate no procedure transaction identity is assigned, used in network-initiated procedures not triggered by UE requests.

relations.description: UE-requested procedure includes sending a request message with PTI.
Request message contains a PTI value.
Response message contains the PTI value from the received request or command.
Command message contains a PTI value, either from request or unassigned.
Command message uses unassigned PTI when not triggered by a UE request.
Network-requested procedure includes sending a command message.
UE-requested procedure may include an accept message with PTI.
UE-requested procedure may include a reject message with PTI.
